sections.heading: Priors disclosure
sections.markdown: What I believe the market narrative is: Indofood CBP (`ICBP.JK`) is Indonesia's dominant instant-noodle/packaged-food franchise (Indomie) controlled by INDF/Salim, a defensive staple whose pricing power and margins are periodically clouded by wheat/CPO inflation and non-cash FX noise on Pinehill USD bonds.

sections.heading: Earnings quality gate
sections.markdown:
- **Board/audit & 9M26:** No *pemantauan khusus*, special notations, or going-concern flags (`coverage/companies/ICBP.JK/report.md` §3, §6); INDF FY25 statements hold an unmodified EY opinion (`coverage/companies/ICBP.JK/sources/S10.txt` p.140). 9M26 figures (`fund record`, `fund record`) are unaudited—expect Q4 true-ups.
- **3y accruals & CFO/NI (`data/dossiers/ICBP.fund record`, `CFO = FCF − Capex`):** FY23A −4.62% (CFO Rp12,415bn / NI Rp6,991bn = 1.78×), FY24A −4.38% (1.76×), FY25A −2.20% (1.31×; CFO Rp12,105bn / NI Rp9,225bn). Cash exceeds book earnings throughout, narrowing on receivables/inventory build (optics-class modern-trade timing, `fund record` §3).
- **D&A restatement:** Direct-method packs show a ~Rp357bn stub (`coverage/companies/ICBP.JK/assumptions.yaml` line 366). INDF's CBP note (`fund record` F1–F2, F13; `fund record` p.291–292; `fund record` p.292) gives D&A of Rp1,659.0bn (FY23), Rp1,788.2bn (FY24), Rp1,861.4bn (FY25, 2.5% of sales), lifting FY25A EBITDA to Rp17,735.1bn.
- **USD debt & Pinehill:** ICBP holds US$2,750m of 2031–2052 USD bonds (`fund record` p.20, Note 19; Rp45,936.3bn = 96.8% of FY25 debt at 16,782 IDR/USD). Long tenors remove refi risk, and Pinehill overseas sales (~Rp27.84trn INDF) + USD cash (US$878.9m INDF, Note 37) partially hedge, but weak IDR drives non-cash FX losses (9M26 NI −14% YoY vs +5% core profit, `fund record`, `fund record`). Pinehill goodwill (Rp52.2trn, 24% of INDF assets) is a Key Audit Matter (`fund record` p.143).
- **Related-party/Salim governance:** INDF owns 80.5% (`fund record` F10). INDF RP sales are 8.41% (Indomaret/Indogrosir) and RP purchases 0.52% (`fund record` p.33, Note 31). ICBP's flour purchases from Bogasari (inter-segment Rp6,607.2bn, `fund record` p.291) eliminate on INDF consolidation and ICBP's standalone 2025 LK failed TLS/IDX fetch (`fund record` §6), leaving standalone RP COGS unverified (~20% bounded). Zero manipulation flags; optics-class only. **Gate: PASS.**

sections.heading: Bottom-up estimates
sections.markdown:
- **Divisional model (`fund record` p.43–50, `fund record` p.42–51, `fund record`):**
  - *Noodles* (FY24/25: Rp53,870/55,850bn; 25.9%/24.4% EBITm): +16.0%/+7.5%/+6.5% FY26E–28E (39bn packs + West Java 2026 plant, Pinehill MEA/SEE, price pass-through) at 24.2%/24.5%/24.7% EBITm.
  - *Dairy* (Rp9,660/9,820bn; 9.6%/8.0%): +10%/+6%/+5.5% at 8.2%/8.5%/8.8% EBITm. *Snacks* (Rp4,540/4,620bn; 10.1%/4.2%): +12%/+8%/+7% (+20% Central Java capacity, `fund record` F11) recovering to 6.0%/7.5%/8.2%. *Seasonings* (Rp4,300/4,600bn; 10.8%/15.3%): +12%/+7%/+6% at ~15.0–15.3%. *Nutrition* (Rp1,360/1,310bn) +6%/+5%/+5% at ~10%; *Beverages* (Rp1,670/1,470bn) +4%/yr at ~15%.
  - Net of eliminations (0.9637 sales factor), consolidated revenue is Rp85,607.6bn (FY26E, 9M26 Rp64,445.7bn annualized, `fund record`), Rp91,787.1bn (FY27E), Rp97,583.9bn (FY28E); EBIT is Rp18,253.4bn (21.3%), Rp19,943.7bn (21.7%), Rp21,461.5bn (22.0%).
- **Agri & FX deck:** Wheat (`d.agri.wheat` 220.8 spot / 293.5 FY27E; 20% COGS, 97% pass-through) and CPO (`d.agri.cpo` 1,180 spot / 1,240 FY27E; 12% COGS, 95% pass-through) leave ~15–20bp net drag, confirmed by 9M26 21.2% EBITm (`fund record`). Net USD debt (~US$2,100m = US$2,750m bonds less ~US$650m USD cash) revaluing from 16,782 along `m.usd_idr` (18,225/18,350/18,600, `the macro regime memo`) drives −Rp3,030bn/Rp263bn/Rp525bn pre-tax FX losses, reconciling FY26E Core EPS Rp955.1 (9M26 core Rp8.04trn, `S2`) to Reported EPS Rp787.1 (9M26 NI Rp6.10trn, `S3`), recovering to Rp1,043.7/1,125.2 in FY27E–28E (22% tax, 17.1% NCI).
- **ROIC, Owner Earnings & 10y Fade DCF (`VAL_COMPOUNDER_QUALITY`):** FY26E–28E reinvestment (Net Capex Rp5,560bn + ΔNWC Rp2,105bn) = 16.5% of NOPAT (Rp46,534bn) → 56.9% headline ROIIC (~32% steady-state × ~18% = ~5.8% organic growth). Parent Owner Earnings (after all capex, 0 SBC, ex non-cash FX): Rp7,582bn (FY25A), Rp8,680bn (FY26E), Rp10,346bn (FY27E), Rp11,560bn (FY28E). DCF uses **11.5% WACC** (in 11–13% IDR band), fading FY29E–35E growth to **4.0% terminal g** (3.28% CPI + 0.72% volume, <8.6% nominal GDP) and EBITm to 20.5% (distribution/brand moat): EV Rp183,505bn (48.9% PV FCFF) less 17.1% NCI (Rp31,379bn) and spot-FX net debt (Rp21,245bn) = **Rp11,223/sh** (10.1× FY26E EV/EBIT; **9.9× Year-10 exit EV/EBIT**—zero multiple expansion). 3-assumption sensitivity: WACC (11.0–12.5%) Rp12,176–9,654; EBITm (−200/+150bp) Rp9,829–12,268; terminal g (3.0–4.5%) Rp10,148–11,875.

sections.heading: Variant perception
sections.markdown:
**Market believes:** At Rp7,050 (~7.4× FY26E Core P/E, ~5.7× EV/EBITDA), IDX staples remain structurally impaired while wheat/CPO costs and USD-debt FX losses (9M26 NI −14% YoY) erode earnings.
**Why wrong:** Pricing power is intact: 9M26 sales +14.5% YoY and EBIT margin 21.2% (`fund record`) confirm ~95%/97% CPO/wheat pass-through via Indomie/Supermi's two-tier brand ladder and distribution moat (`fund record` p.27, p.40). Non-cash FX translation on 2031–2052 USD bonds hides +5% core profit growth (`fund record`). Base Rp11,223 implies 9.9× exit EV/EBIT—zero return to >30× UNVR multiples needed.
**What proves us wrong:** Two quarters of EBIT margin <18.5%, revenue growth <3%, or an adverse Bogasari/related-party pricing shift.

sections.heading: House coverage reconciliation
sections.markdown: Our Base **Rp11,223/sh** sits 21% below house `tp_final` **Rp14,294/sh** (`coverage/companies/ICBP.JK/model.json`, `fund record` §4) for three reasons: (1) house `fund record` discounts at **10.72% WACC**, outside `VAL_COMPOUNDER_QUALITY`'s 11–13% IDR band, whereas we enforce **11.5% WACC** under `balance_of_payments_pressure` (~−Rp1,300/sh); (2) house DCF deducts book NCI (Rp22,471bn) and book net debt (Rp16,996bn ex-investments) to reach Rp15,317/sh, whereas we deduct full 17.1% EV share for Pinehill minorities (Rp31,379bn) and mark USD debt to spot **18,225 IDR/USD** (Rp21,245bn net debt); and (3) house blends 60% DCF with 30% trailing P/E (Rp10,019) and 10% EV/EBITDA (Rp10,238) rolled 12 months forward (`tp_base` Rp14,564, weighted `tp_final` Rp14,294), whereas we anchor solely on un-rolled 10y DCF.

sections.heading: Disconfirming facts
sections.markdown:
1. 9M26 parent NI fell 14.1% YoY to Rp6.10trn (`fund record` para 3; Q2-26 NI Rp1,128.7bn, `fund record`) on USD-debt FX losses.
2. FY25 Noodles EBITm fell 150bp to 24.4% (`fund record` p.43 vs 25.9% FY24, `fund record` p.42); Snacks EBITm fell to 4.2% (from 10.1%) on CPO/potato costs (`fund record` p.46).
3. Accruals narrowed from −4.62% (FY23) to −2.20% (FY25, `fund record`) on receivables/inventory build (`fund record` §3); standalone Bogasari flour COGS % is unverified (`fund record` p.33, `fund record` §6).
4. Forward `d.agri.wheat` (FY27E 293.5 vs spot 220.8) and `m.usd_idr` (18,225→18,850, `the macro regime memo`) pose ongoing lag/FX headwinds.

sections.heading: Pre-mortem
sections.markdown: It is November 2029 and this position lost 30%. The most likely reason is wheat/CPO inflation plus value-tier discounting broke ICBP's pass-through (EBITm 20,000, depressing reported EPS and keeping IDX staples de-rated. An ARB-locked exit below Rp5,200 fills 15% lower (~Rp4,420, −37.3%).

sections.heading: Judge verdict
sections.markdown:
**VERDICT: PASS_REDUCED (`size_multiplier: 0.25`, starter) — resting limit at Rp6,325.**

*Standing correction:* Against inception's 35/40 kill bias (12/28 scored kills left gains; calibration `n=0`), I reserve KILL for dispositive flaws, use resting limits for spot-price objections, and shrink size via `size_multiplier` when inputs are unverified.

1. **Process & lint:** `the thesis linter` passes (`problems: []`); `estimates_committed_at` (`10:10:19`) precedes `draft` (`10:12:25`), `stage_log` is monotonic (`ANALYST_INDO → BEAR → ANALYST_INDO`), no `the kill ledger` cooldown on `ICBP.JK`, and house coverage divergence (Rp9,574 revised target vs BUY Rp14,294) is reconciled via 12.5% WACC, 17.1% NCI, and spot-FX debt.

3. **Bear's strongest point:** Paying Rp7,050 above Bear DCF (Rp6,413) while 9M26 EBIT margin fell 140bp YoY (22.6%→21.2%) with unverified standalone USD cash/LK and missing challenger share data lacked safety margin. Dani resolved price by cutting entry to Rp6,325 (patient limit below Bear Rp6,413) and cutting target to Rp9,574 under zero-USD-cash stress (`-Rp80/sh`).
4. **Why `0.25` starter, not `0.5` or `KILL`:** Missing challenger share data (Mie Sedaap/Lemonilo) leave the structural-vs-cyclical de-rating test (`VAL_COMPOUNDER_QUALITY` #6) unverified, alongside unarchived ICBP standalone LK/Bogasari COGS.
